notes.title: Patch Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Hey all you ghost and ghouls,

It seems the  current spells cast on the castle has made a few of you uncomfortable. The witch is brewing some potions and altering things that will ease your stay at the manor. Don't be alarmed! Nothing to crazy is happening.... She just knows stressed captives cause her potions to brew different.  Here's what you have to look forward to in her next batch of spells.

[list]
[*] Adjustable controls in the Menu 
[*] Volume controls for in game audio (Background sound)
[*] In game chat controls (muting other players)
[*] Updated book font
[*] Updated UI

[/list]
